title: TMDL Syntax Rules
description: Machine-readable TMDL best practices for Power BI semantic models derived from tmdl_best_practices.md

rules.name: Pure TAB Indentation Required
rules.description: TMDL files must use TAB characters only for indentation. Mixed Tab+Space combinations cause parser errors in Power BI Desktop.

rules.name: No description Property Allowed
rules.description: Property 'description:' is not supported in TMDL format. Use /// comments on the line before measure/column definitions instead.
rules.errorExample:
measure 'Sales' = SUM([Amount])
  description: "Total sales"  // ❌ PARSER ERROR

rules.name: M-Expression Requires let...in Block
rules.description: M-expressions in partition sources must use let...in block to avoid Composite Model entity-based query errors.
rules.fixDescription: Wrap inline expression in let...in block with type table
rules.correctExample:
source =
    let
        Source = #table(type table [], {})
    in
        Source

rules.name: FormatString Required for Numeric Measures
rules.description: All numeric measures should define formatString for consistent display formatting. Missing formatString causes default 'General Number' formatting.

rules.name: DisplayFolder Required for Measures
rules.description: All measures should define displayFolder for organizational structure. Missing displayFolder causes measures to appear at table root.

rules.name: Documentation Comment Required for Measures
rules.description: All measures should have /// documentation comment on the line before definition for AI/Copilot readiness.

rules.name: Avoid Calculated Columns for Business Logic
rules.description: Calculated columns do not compress as well as data columns. Business logic should be implemented via measures, not calculated columns.

rules.name: Use Star Schema Relationships Only
rules.description: Snowflake relationships (dimension → dimension) should be avoided. Use star schema pattern (fact → dimension only).

rules.name: Limit Bi-Directional Relationships
rules.description: Bi-directional relationships can cause performance degradation and ambiguity. Use single-direction relationships where possible.

rules.name: LineageTag Required for All Objects
rules.description: All tables, columns, and measures should have lineageTag for change tracking and deployment lineage.
